preconditions.description: Input parameters n, k, l, r, sall, sk are within the specified bounds and satisfy k <= n and l <= r.
It is guaranteed that a valid distribution of scores exists for the given input.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers representing the scores of the n students.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= x <= r for x in scores)
postconditions.description: Every student's score is between l and r inclusive.
The sum of all student scores equals sall.
The sum of the k highest scores equals sk.
